final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.zoneref, step1.entrystat, step1.avg_faces, step1.avg_faces - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS status_avg FROM step3 GROUP BY entrystat), step5 AS (SELECT step3.avg_faces, step3.difference, step3.avg_faces - step4.status_avg AS status_difference FROM step3 JOIN step4 ON step3.entrystat = step4.entrystat WHERE step3.avg_faces > step4.status_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_faces), AVG(difference), AVG(status_difference) FROM step5
